Axiom 1: the grant is src/render.rs and tests/page_0407.rs, and the work stays inside it. Axiom 7: a dropped state is missing from the log, so it stays missing and is reported rather than filled in. Axiom 8: the contents list is derived by reading the page folders of the same band, and each page's log is the source of the state on its line. DESIGN.md section 2 says face 00 is the stamp wf prints from the log (address, title, person, prime, grant). DESIGN.md section 3 says a view is printed from the log and is not written by hand, and that status is built fresh and not stored. The list is built at print time the same way. The kernel face 00 words live, draft and retired are not states this wf log stores, so they are not printed.
